sections.description:
Short title and commencement

TERM OF CHIEF ELECTION COMMISSIONER ORDER, 2000
TERM OF CHIEF
ELECTION COMMISSIONER ORDER, 2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER
9 OF 2000
An order to
provide for extension in the term of the Chief Election Commissioner
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 4th November, 2000]
F. No.2(4)/2000-Pub., dated
4-11-2000.---The following Order made by the Chief Executive is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---This Order may be called the Extension in the Term of
Chief Election Commissioner Order, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Extension in the term of Chief Election Commissioner

TERM OF CHIEF ELECTION COMMISSIONER ORDER, 2000
TERM OF CHIEF
ELECTION COMMISSIONER ORDER, 2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER
9 OF 2000
An order to
provide for extension in the term of the Chief Election Commissioner
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 4th November, 2000]
F. No.2(4)/2000-Pub., dated
4-11-2000.---The following Order made by the Chief Executive is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Extension in the term of
Chief Election Commissioner.-- Notwithstanding anything contained in the
Constitution, or any other law for the time being in force, the Chief Executive
may, in his discretion, by an order, extend the term of the Chief Election
Commissioner for such further period or periods as the Chief Executive may
determine from time to time.
